text:
One watch, two time zones. The GMT hand is the reason.

A GMT watch adds a hand that makes one full turn every 24 hours. Read it against the 24-hour scale and you have a second city's time. Turn the bezel and you can track a third.

Rolex GMT-Master II (126710GRNR) lists at $12,000. Tudor Black Bay GMT (M79830RB-0003) lists at $4,925. Prices are US retail, checked 26 November 2026.

Which would you wear for a second time zone, the Rolex or the Tudor?

Source: Gear Patrol, "The GMT Watch, Explained" (how a GMT hand works); Watches of Switzerland product pages, US prices checked 26 November 2026.
